description: Listed building consent for alterations to the existing roof including; repainting and repairing the steel framework, overlaying roof terraces with a waterproof material, replacement of felt within pitched roof with new felt system, redecoration of high level windows and installation of new velux windows to central internal corridor.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (JHP RS173 - 101; JHP RS173 - 102; Planning Statement and Heritage Impact Assessment; Design and Access Statement; Received:  20 April 2021; JHP RS19.4 - SP; JHP RS173 - 002;  Received:  04 March 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
